scheme_name: Scholarship Scheme For Disabled Students To Study Abroad For Higher Education
other_conditions: Applicant must have a disability of at least 40%
Applicant's name must be registered on the Sparsh portal
Only one child per family is eligible, and only once
Eligibility for postgraduate degree requires first class or 60% marks (or equivalent) in the bachelor's degree

Eligibility for research degree (PhD) requires first class or 60% marks in the relevant postgraduate examination plus either two years of teaching/research/professional experience in the relevant field or an M.Phil degree
Eligibility for studies after the research degree requires first class or 60% marks (or equivalent) in the relevant postgraduate examination and a research degree (PhD) with relevant experience
